about: Bộ ảnh MINH HOẠ mẫu của lõi (ADR 0252): tạo bằng AI (Gemini ảnh, bản Flash 'Nano Banana' — gemini-nano-banana-2.1) ngày 21/11/2026, KHÔNG có người thật, chữ, logo hay thương hiệu thật. Mọi ảnh là ảnh AI tạo — khi dùng trong ấn phẩm bắt buộc in chú thích 'Ảnh minh hoạ'; thay bằng ảnh thật của dự án / công ty trước khi gửi khách khi có thể. Định dạng JPEG (trình duyệt đưa JPEG vào PDF nguyên bản — WebP bị giải nén làm PDF phình gấp nhiều lần).
origin: tạo bằng AI — ảnh minh hoạ

images.label: Khu đô thị nhìn từ trên cao lúc hoàng hôn
images.prompt: Aerial view at golden hour of a modern master-planned urban district in a Southeast Asian city: clusters of contemporary residential towers with glass and pale stone facades, wide tree-lined boulevards, a large central park with a lake, low-rise townhouses, soft warm light, a few distant clouds.

images.label: Khu đô thị ven mặt nước lúc chạng vạng
images.prompt: Wide cinematic view at dusk of a contemporary residential township: elegant towers of varying heights rising behind a landscaped promenade with a reflective water feature, warm lights glowing in windows, deep blue sky, clean modern architecture.

images.label: Toà căn hộ nhìn từ dưới lên
images.prompt: Dramatic low-angle upward view of a slender modern residential tower with a rhythmic facade of balconies, glass and light stone fins, against a clear soft blue morning sky with a few wisps of cloud.

images.label: Phòng khách căn hộ nhìn ra thành phố
images.prompt: Bright modern apartment living room with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking a city skyline, light oak flooring, neutral linen sofa, a low marble coffee table, green plants, soft natural daylight, tidy and uncluttered, no people.

images.label: Phòng ngủ chính căn hộ
images.prompt: Serene master bedroom in a contemporary apartment, king bed with white and sand-coloured linen, wooden headboard wall, sheer curtains, bedside lamps glowing softly, morning light, minimalist and calm, no people.

images.label: Bếp và bàn ăn căn hộ
images.prompt: Modern open kitchen and dining area of a premium apartment, white quartz island, brushed-brass pendant lamps, light wood cabinets, a bowl of fruit, daylight from a large window, immaculate, no people.

images.label: Sảnh toà nhà hai tầng
images.prompt: Grand double-height lobby of a premium residential tower, warm stone floor, feature wall in timber slats, soft indirect lighting, sculptural seating area, reception desk without any signage, floor-to-ceiling glass, no people.

images.label: Sảnh và khu tiếp khách (dải ngang)
images.prompt: Panoramic wide shot of a luxury residential lobby and lounge, long reception counter in marble, warm cove lighting, polished floor reflecting light, symmetrical composition, no people, no signage.

images.label: Hồ bơi tiện ích trên tầng thượng khối đế
images.prompt: Resort-style infinity swimming pool on the podium level of a residential complex at late afternoon, sun loungers with white cushions, tropical landscaping, residential towers rising behind, warm golden light, no people.

images.label: Vườn nội khu có lối đi dạo
images.prompt: Landscaped inner garden of a residential complex, curved walking path, mature trees, flower beds, wooden benches, soft morning sunlight filtering through leaves, peaceful, no people.

images.label: Đường chân trời thành phố bên sông (dải ngang)
images.prompt: Panoramic skyline strip of a modern city at blue hour seen across a river, rows of towers with lit windows, reflections on the water, a bridge in the distance, calm and elegant.

images.label: Văn phòng mở / không gian làm việc chung
images.prompt: Bright contemporary open-plan office and co-working space, wooden desks, ergonomic chairs, large windows, plants, glass meeting room, tidy, daylight, no people, no screens showing text.

images.label: Quán cà phê / cửa hàng nhỏ
images.prompt: Cosy modern cafe and retail shop interior, light wood counter, pendant lamps, shelves with plain unbranded ceramic cups and plants, warm daylight from the window, inviting, no people, no signage.

images.label: Phòng trị liệu spa
images.prompt: Tranquil spa treatment room with a massage bed draped in white towels, warm wood panelling, candles, orchids, natural stone basin, soft diffuse light, no people.

images.label: Lớp học trống
images.prompt: Bright empty modern classroom with wooden desks and chairs arranged in rows, large windows, a clean whiteboard with no writing, colourful but unbranded shelves, daylight, welcoming, no people.

images.label: Kho logistics nhìn dọc lối đi (dải ngang)
images.prompt: Wide panoramic view inside a modern logistics warehouse, long aisles of tall racks with plain cardboard boxes, polished concrete floor, skylights with soft light, orderly, no people, no text, no logos.
